failures.name: annotation-shape-identity-engine-tests
failures.detail: The first schema witness incorrectly marked projection parameters Inferred, which canonicalized their order before the test. Structural projections reify Explicit parameter origins. Corrected the fixture to Explicit while retaining every positive and negative expected result. The final eight-test annotation selection passes.

failures.name: connected-collector-path-tally-first-execution
failures.detail: The combined native transport requires 1103136 bytes, exceeding the unchanged 1048576-byte default. Rejected before allocation or execution. The new diagnostic declares a finite 2 MiB transport allowance and verifies success -> unchanged default denial -> success, zero rejection allocations, unchanged prior output owners, input aliases and cleanup. No earlier test allowance or compiler default was changed. The old diagnostic field completed_positions=8 denoted the intended case size; actual completed positions at this preflight rejection were zero. Passing final measurements use the corrected field.
